title: X-Men #5 #6 Lot Marvel 2013 Battle of the Atom Brian Wood Arthur Adams Cover
condition_description: Both bright with light handling wear; light edge wear on #6 back cover. See photos.
description:
Lot of 2: X-Men #5 and #6 (2013, vol. 4), Marvel Comics - Battle of the Atom chapters 3 and 7. Written by Brian Wood, art by David Lopez with Cam Smith, colors by Laura Martin. #5 cover by Arthur Adams. Direct editions, $3.99 cover price each.

Back covers: #5 Harley-Davidson "Smoke Break" ad; #6 Harley-Davidson Fat Bob "Sick Day" ad.

Condition: both bright with light handling wear; light edge wear on the #6 back cover (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
